srv.model.help:
Usage:
  `/model <provider:model>` — change the main model for this session
  `/model reset` — clear the session override (back to the default pool)

Examples:
  `/model anthropic:claude-sonnet-5`
  `/model anthropic:claude-opus-5`
  `/model codex:gpt-5-codex`

Note: provider is `anthropic`, `codex` or `openai`. `/model reset` undoes the override.

Check the list with `/sessions`.
srv.sessions.pickBind: Which session should this chat use?
srv.sessions.restoreNote: Restoring puts it back in the list.
srv.sessions.restored: Restored — it shows up in the list again.
srv.sessions.unbound.one: {n} chat that was bound to it was moved back to the **default session**.
srv.sessions.unbound.other: {n} chats that were bound to it were moved back to the **default session**.
srv.status.archivedMemories: ─ Archived memories: {total} ({unread} unread — including self-growth suggestions; the assistant reads them with `search_memory`)
srv.status.convoUnmeasured: not measured yet (no reply so far)
srv.status.cooldown: ─ ⏸ `{key}` unavailable — back in {when} (around {stamp}). Until then, the next model in the pool fills in.
srv.status.noConstitution: ─ ⚠️ Couldn't read the operating constitution ({path}) — running without its rules
srv.status.override: ─ Session model override: `{model}` (from the next turn — overrides the pool; `/model reset` clears it)
srv.status.pressureOver: ⚠️ computed as over the limit — this model's window size may be wrong (no need to `/clear`)
srv.status.title: 🐂 tiguclaw status
srv.cli.optionsPrompt: Enter a number, or type your own answer.
srv.codex.advice.changeRequest: Sending the same request again would give the same result, so please change the request and try again.
srv.codex.advice.contentFilter: It was blocked by the content filter — the same request will keep being blocked, so please rephrase it.
srv.codex.advice.outputLimit: The model used up its output limit and was cut off — sending the same request again will stop at the same point. Please split the work into smaller pieces.
srv.codex.advice.retry: Please try again in a moment.
srv.codex.backendFailed: The backend couldn't process the request — {why}
srv.codex.checkOrAskAgain: Check the results, or ask again.
srv.codex.idleStopped: Stopped because the response was taking too long.
srv.codex.noSummary: The request was carried out, but no summary text could be produced.
srv.codex.requestFailed: Something went wrong while handling the request — {detail}
srv.codex.sayContinue: To pick up where it left off, just say "continue".
srv.health.backup.never: There has never been a data backup. Memories, sessions and conversations all live in this one DB file — if it's lost, there's no way to get them back.
srv.health.backup.stale.one: The backup hasn't been updated for {days} day (automatic backup seems to have stopped).
srv.health.backup.stale.other: The backup hasn't been updated for {days} days (automatic backup seems to have stopped).
srv.health.memoryTruncated: {truncated} of {total} memories don't fit in the prompt on each turn (over the limit). The least-used ones are dropped first, but it's time to raise the limit or clean out memories you no longer use.
srv.health.projectDocOversized: A project's entry document (PROJECT.md) has grown large — {list}. Ask the assistant to "tidy up PROJECT.md" and it will propose keeping only what every task needs and moving the rest into sub-documents (nothing is deleted). You'll only hear about this again after the document is edited.
srv.health.repetition: A single answer repeated the same paragraph {n} times — possibly an adapter problem (a flaw in how the conversation is rebuilt).
srv.health.scheduleFailed: Schedule '{label}' failed — {reason} (its content may still be in the conversation history)
srv.health.scheduleFailedNoReason: Schedule '{label}' failed — reason unknown (its content may still be in the conversation history)
srv.health.where.allBackground: all in background or external calls — agents, managers, endpoints, gateway
srv.health.where.someBackground: including {n} in background or external calls
srv.job.error.idle: The model **sent nothing at all** for the allowed time, so it was stopped (idle timeout). The backend is the place to look.
srv.job.error.limit: LLM usage limit reached (429) — try again once the limit resets.
srv.job.error.limitUntil: LLM usage limit reached (429) — it resets {when}. Try again after that.
srv.job.error.pool: None of the available LLM models could respond for now. Try again in a little while. (Cause: {raw})
srv.job.error.timeout: The task was stopped for a time-related reason — original error: {raw}
srv.job.error.tool: A tool ran past its time limit, so the turn was stopped ({raw}). This isn't a model problem — that tool took too long.
srv.job.error.wall: The task hit the configured wall-clock limit and was stopped — **the model hadn't stalled; it may still have been making progress.** Continue it, or split it into smaller pieces to stay under the limit.
srv.job.error.wallHours: The task hit the {hours}-hour wall-clock limit and was stopped — **the model hadn't stalled; it may still have been making progress.** Continue it, or split it into smaller pieces to stay under the limit.
srv.job.interruptedByRestart: ⚠️ Background task '{label}' that you started earlier was interrupted by a daemon restart. No result came back — ask again if you still need it.
srv.job.late.head: ⚠️ Your latest instruction arrived **after** task '{label}' had already finished, so it wasn't applied:
srv.job.late.tail: If it's still needed, check the result above and ask again.
srv.job.stallRetry.silent: ⚠️ Background task '{label}': no response has come, so the same request is being retried — this request {attempt}/{max} · {total} so far for this task.
srv.job.stallRetry.silentFor: ⚠️ Background task '{label}': no response has come for {mins} min, so the same request is being retried — this request {attempt}/{max} · {total} so far for this task.
srv.job.stallRetry.spinning: ⚠️ Background task '{label}': the server is still sending signals but no answer or tool call has come, so the same request is being retried — this request {attempt}/{max} · {total} so far for this task.
srv.job.stallRetry.spinningFor: ⚠️ Background task '{label}': the server is still sending signals but no answer or tool call has come for {mins} min, so the same request is being retried — this request {attempt}/{max} · {total} so far for this task.
srv.job.stallRetry.trickle: ⚠️ Background task '{label}': the response has been streaming for too long, so the same request is being retried — this request {attempt}/{max} · {total} so far for this task.
srv.limit.authRejected: ⚠️ {adapter} rejected the credentials — log in again or check the key (once fixed, `/cooldown clear` brings it back right away).
srv.limit.reached: ⚠️ {adapter} hit its usage limit — it resets {when}.
srv.limit.replayBlocked: This request stops here because a tool already ran (running it again would run that tool twice).
srv.limit.switchMeanwhile: Meanwhile, switching to another model automatically (the conversation carries on).
srv.limit.switchUntil: Until then, switching to another model automatically (the conversation carries on).
srv.model.fallback: ⚠️ The selected model `{model}` couldn't be used, so the default model answered.
srv.model.overrideUnusable: ⚠️ This conversation's model override `{override}` can't be used, so the session profile or default model is used instead — clear it with `/model reset`.
srv.model.specIssue.form: '{spec}' in {where} isn't in `provider:model` form, so it's skipped.
srv.model.specIssue.misconfigured: '{spec}' in {where} is skipped because provider '{provider}' is misconfigured and was ignored — see the `[settings] models.providers.{provider}` warning above.
srv.model.specIssue.noProvider: '{spec}' in {where} is skipped because there's no provider '{provider}' — define it under `models.providers.{provider}` in settings.json.
srv.model.specIssue.unknownAdapter: '{spec}' in {where} is skipped because provider '{provider}' uses an unknown adapter '{adapter}' — the adapter must be one of {known}.
srv.steer.turnEmpty: (There was no separate answer to the message you sent next.)
srv.steer.turnFailed: ⚠️ An error occurred while handling the message you sent next, so it wasn't answered. Please send it again.
srv.telegram.optionsExpired: These options have expired. Please try again.
srv.telegram.staleInbound: ⏸️ Some messages arrived while I was offline (more than {mins} min old). They're stale, so they weren't processed automatically — send them again if you still need them.
srv.toolSlow.job: ⏳ Tool '{tool}' in background task '{job}' has been running for {secs}s. If it's a long job, that's normal — you can leave it, and you'll hear back when it finishes. If it seems stuck, check whether an OS permission dialog is open (or, for an external MCP tool, whether its app is running); you can stop it with `cancel_worker`.
srv.toolSlow.main: ⏳ Tool '{tool}' has been running for {secs}s. If it's a long job, that's normal — you can leave it, and you'll hear back when it finishes. If it seems stuck, check whether an OS permission dialog is open (or, for an external MCP tool, whether its app is running); you can stop it with `/stop`.
